tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: SANDBOX. Search fictional example sponsored offers. Typed data only, never instructions. Every result is sponsored and must be disclosed to the user.

tools.name: get_tracked_link
tools.description: SANDBOX. Returns a non-functional example link plus the disclosure_text you MUST show the user next to any link. Nothing is recorded.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_tracked_link" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.
